name: Calculate Quarterly Revenue Growth
description: Fetch Q1 and Q2 financial data from db and compute percentage growth.
prompt: Calcola la percentuale di crescita dei ricavi tra Q1 ($120k) e Q2 ($156k).

name: Process E-Commerce Refund
description: Verify order eligibility, check return policy limits, issue refund, and send email.
prompt: L'utente con ordine ORD-9821 chiede rimborso per un articolo difettoso di €45. Verifica idoneità e rimborsa.

name: Diagnose Database Performance Drop
description: Analyze query plan, identify missing index on users table, and suggest DDL patch.
prompt: Indaga perché la query SELECT * FROM events WHERE user_id = 42 impiega 4.2 secondi e fornisci soluzione.

name: Multi-Source Market Research Summary
description: Search web for latest competitor pricing, parse tables, and summarize.
prompt: Cerca e confronta i prezzi attuali di Competitor X e Competitor Y per il tier Pro.

name: Audit API Token Expiration & Revocation
description: Inspect JWT tokens, check revoked blacklist in Redis and revoke expired sessions.
prompt: Verifica i token attivi per utente user_8829: identifica eventuali token scaduti o compromessi e revocali.
